simple.meaning: עֵשָׂו (ʻÊsâv) appears 97 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, Jeremiah, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 25:25. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵשָׂו (H6215) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֵשָׂו through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עֵשָׂו (ʻÊsâv) / H6215 is tracked through Genesis 25:25, Genesis 25:26, Genesis 25:27, Genesis 25:28. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: Esav , a son of Isaac, including his posterity
definitions.full: H6215. Esav עֵשָׂו 97 proper name, masculine Esau , Ησαυ ; — Esau , elder son of Isaac Gen 25:25-26 , 7 t. 25, 26:34 ; 27:1 24 t. 27:27-28 , 32:4 15 t. 32:32 , 33, 35, Josh 24:4 (twice in verse); Mal 1:2-3 , 1Chr 1:34 ; identification with אֱדוֺם Gen 36:1 , 8 , 19 , ancestor of Edomites 36:9 ; 36:43 , compare 1Chr 1:35 ; dwelling in Mt. Seir Gen 36:8 (25 t. in all, Genesis 36) Deut 2:5 ; Josh 24:4 ; עֵשָׂו בְּנֵי = Edomites Deut 2:4 , 8 , 12 , 22 , 29 ; עֵשָׂו = Edom Jer 49:8 ; Obadiah 6, עֵשָׂו בֵּית 49:18 ; 49:18 , עֵשָׂו הַר 49:18 ; 49:9 ; 49:19 ; 49:21 .
definitions.rootNote: apparently a form of the passive participle of 6213 in the original sense of handling; rough (i.e. sensibly felt);
